_tmp_probe_note: verify/_tmp-*.mjs IS DECLARED THIS TIME. The Day 6 handoff recorded the advice, the satin-blue-field scope was written without it, and the guard duly blocked a throwaway probe on 31 July — the third block in two chunks.
